---
title: "Ingest SDMs: NCCOS Atlantic & Pacific Seabird Densities"
subtitle: "Seasonal seabird density (#/km²) → population-percentile suitability [1,100] on the global 0.05° grid"
msens:
  target_name: ingest_sdm_nc
  workflow_type: ingest
  dependency: [build_cell_grid]
  output: data/manifests/ingest_sdm_nc.json
  dataset: {ds_key: nc, response_type: density, source_authority: NOAA NCCOS, temporal_interval: seasonal, native_format: raster,
            description: "NOAA NCCOS at-sea seabird models, seasonal: Pacific (Leirness et al. 2021) are densities (n per km2); Atlantic (Winship et al. 2018) are a RELATIVE density index, not an absolute abundance. Mapped onto [1,100] by the population-percentile transform (ud), which is scale-free, so both are treated alike. Multi-species guilds are ingested for review (is_guild) and excluded from the merge.",
            value_info: "population percentile of the cell's density within its model (100 = densest cell; val >= 100 - p is the p % core); per-model response_type is density (Pacific) or relative_index (Atlantic 2018)"}
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

NCCOS at-sea seabird **density** models, Atlantic [@winship2018] + Pacific [@leirness2021], as
seasonal COGs (`n_per_km2`, 2-km, oblique-mercator). v11 rasterizes each (species × season × region)
onto the global 0.05° cell grid and maps the heavy-tailed density onto the merge's **[1,100]** scale
by the **population-percentile** transform (`msens::density_to_suit(method = "ud")`), plus an
**annual** surface for scoring.

- **Source COGs** (in-repo): `data/sdm/raw/nc_atl_birds_dens/*.tif` (140) + `nc_pac_birds_dens/*.tif`
  (135); band 1 = `n_per_km2` (bands 2/3 = CV/CI). Also public at
  `file.marinesensitivity.org/cog/sdm/raw/{ds}/{sp_code}_{season}.tif` (served natively via titiler).
- **`mdl_key`**: seasonal `nc|{sp_id}|{season}` + annual `nc|{sp_id}`. `sp_id` is `GBIF:…` for a
  species and `GUILD:{sp_code}` for the 13 multi-species guilds (these used to land under the
  genus/family GBIF id with `is_guild = FALSE`, and three of them shared an id with a real species).
  Regions (atl/pac) are spatially disjoint and **unioned** per `sp_id`.
- **Value transform (v11 Q6, D12).** Per model (species × season × region), AFTER regridding:
  `val = density_to_suit(d, "ud", area = cell area_km2)` — 100 minus the percent of the modelled
  population in cells strictly denser than this one, so the densest cell is 100 and the cells with
  `val >= 100 - p` are exactly the p % core. Cells with `val < 1` are dropped (the merge's floor). It is
  scale-free, which is why the Atlantic 2018 index and the Pacific densities are treated alike.
  The old recipe (`NC_TRANSFORM=cap`: linear to the species' pooled p99.5 of positive density, which left
  most cells near 0) stays available and is compared with it below.
- **Annual** = `msens::density_annual(n_intervals = 4)` on the DENSITIES — a season NCCOS did not
  model counts as zero — and THEN the same transform. The v8 ingest averaged the transformed values
  over the seasons a cell was *present* in, biasing the annual upward for the sparsest species.
- **Crosswalk** (`data/nc_taxon_crosswalk.csv`, written HERE): common name first, then scientific
  name, then explicit overrides, resolved to the BirdLife `sisid` (the `bl` model table) and the WoRMS
  AphiaID (`spp.duckdb`). `model_nc.csv` carries `sisid`, `worms_id`, `is_guild`, `response_type`;
  `merge_models_prep.qmd` excludes `is_guild` rows.

> **Not yet folded into merge/scoring** (a flagged scoring change, `FOLD_DENSITY`).
>
> **Atlantic source.** The Winship et al. (2018) product is a *relative density index* ("relative
> density … not the actual number"), which the `ud` transform is indifferent to. NCCOS 2023-060
> (monthly, 10 km, 49 species) would replace the Atlantic set when acquired; `NC_ATL_SOURCE` is the
> placeholder for that switch and accepts only `2018` today.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

librarian::shelf(arrow, DBI, dplyr, duckdb, fs, glue, here, jsonlite, logger, purrr, readr, sf, stringr,
                 terra, tibble, tidyr, quiet = T)
library(msens)                      # the installed msens (density_to_suit / density_annual); never via shelf(), which can reinstall a stale main
source(here("libs/paths.R"))
source(here("libs/vars.R"))
source(here("libs/duckdb_budget.R"))
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || all(is.na(a))) b else a

ds_key   <- "nc"
dir_atlas <- glue("{dir_big_v}/marine-atlas")
dir_dist <- glue("{dir_atlas}/dist/dataset={ds_key}"); dir_create(dir_dist)
mdl_csv  <- glue("{dir_atlas}/dist/model_{ds_key}.csv")
manifest <- here("data/manifests/ingest_sdm_nc.json"); dir_create(path_dir(manifest))
xw_csv   <- here("data/nc_taxon_crosswalk.csv")
cmp_csv  <- here("data/nc_transform_compare.csv")
cog_base <- "https://file.marinesensitivity.org/cog/sdm/raw"
p_cap    <- 0.995                      # the density percentile the OLD recipe used as the 100 point
stopifnot(file_exists(cellid_tif))

# flags (this notebook's own; default = the v11 recipe) ----
nc_transform  <- tolower(Sys.getenv("NC_TRANSFORM", "ud"))        # ud (v11) | cap (the v8 recipe, for comparison)
nc_atl_source <- Sys.getenv("NC_ATL_SOURCE", "2018")              # Atlantic source: only Winship 2018 today
stopifnot("NC_TRANSFORM must be 'ud' or 'cap'" = nc_transform %in% c("ud", "cap"))
if (nc_atl_source != "2018")
  stop("NC_ATL_SOURCE='", nc_atl_source, "' is not available: only the Winship et al. (2018) set ('2018') is ",
       "acquired; NCCOS 2023-060 (monthly, 10 km, 49 spp) must be ingested before it can replace it", call. = FALSE)
log_info("nc: transform = {nc_transform}; Atlantic source = {nc_atl_source}; redo = {redo_ingest}")

if (redo_ingest && dir_exists(dir_dist)) { dir_delete(dir_dist); dir_create(dir_dist) }

# write one model surface as (mdl_key, cell_id, val) parquet. ssn = NA -> annual key/file.
pq_path <- function(safe, ssn) if (is.na(ssn)) glue("{dir_dist}/{ds_key}_{safe}.parquet") else
                                              glue("{dir_dist}/{ds_key}_{safe}_{ssn}.parquet")
write_parquet_row <- function(d, sid, ssn, safe) {
  mk <- if (is.na(ssn)) glue("{ds_key}|{sid}") else glue("{ds_key}|{sid}|{ssn}")
  msens::write_atlas_parquet(                              # V2/zstd/80MB row groups (Phase A)
    tibble(mdl_key = as.character(mk), cell_id = as.integer(d$cell_id), val = d$val),
    pq_path(safe, ssn))
}
```

## Cell areas

The `ud` transform weights each cell by its area (the population in a cell is density × area). The
`cell` table is a property of the grid, not of the release: this version's `sdm.duckdb` is used when
`build_cell_grid` has written it, else `ver_prev`'s (which `build_cell_grid` copies unchanged).

```{r}
#| label: cell-area

sdm_cell_db <- c(sdm_db, glue("{dir_big}/{ver_prev}/sdm.duckdb")) |> path_expand() |> keep(file_exists) |> first()
stopifnot("no sdm.duckdb with a cell table (this version's or ver_prev's)" = !is.null(sdm_cell_db))
log_info("cell areas from {sdm_cell_db}")
con_sdm <- dbConnect(duckdb(sdm_cell_db, read_only = TRUE))
duckdb_tune(con_sdm, glue("{dir_big_v}/_tmp/nc"))
ca <- dbGetQuery(con_sdm, "SELECT cell_id, area_km2 FROM cell")
dbDisconnect(con_sdm, shutdown = TRUE)
area_by_id <- rep(NA_real_, 7200 * 3600); area_by_id[ca$cell_id] <- ca$area_km2
# the cell table holds the OCEAN cells only (17.07 M of 25.92 M), while the regridded surfaces fade into
# land cells along the coast (whole range, no land mask): those take the area of their latitude row
# (a cell's area depends on its row alone; the table's rows are constant to 1e-9 relative)
row_of <- \(id) (id - 1L) %/% 7200L + 1L
a_row  <- ca |> mutate(row = row_of(cell_id)) |> group_by(row) |>
  summarise(a = first(area_km2), spread = max(area_km2) / min(area_km2) - 1, .groups = "drop")
stopifnot("cell area is not constant within a row" = max(a_row$spread) < 1e-6)
area_by_row <- rep(NA_real_, 3600); area_by_row[a_row$row] <- a_row$a
cell_area <- function(id) {
  a <- area_by_id[id]; miss <- is.na(a)
  if (any(miss)) a[miss] <- area_by_row[row_of(id[miss])]
  stopifnot("a cell id has no area (no ocean cell in its row)" = !anyNA(a), all(a > 0))
  a }
log_info("cell table: {nrow(ca)} ocean cells, area {round(min(ca$area_km2), 3)}-{round(max(ca$area_km2), 1)} km2; ",
         "land cells take their row's area")
rm(ca)
```

## Models + species crosswalk

```{r}
#| label: models

# one row per (region, sp_code, season) at band 1 (density)
m <- read_csv(here("data/nc_models.csv")) |>
  filter(var == "n_per_km2") |>
  transmute(region_ds = ds_key, region, sp_code, season, cog_url,
            response_type = if_else(region == "Atlantic", "relative_index", "density"))
stopifnot("unexpected region" = all(m$region %in% c("Atlantic", "Pacific")))

# sp_code -> GBIF id / names, unioned across the two regions' crosswalks
read_xw <- function(f) read_csv(f) |>
  transmute(sp_code, gbif_id = as.character(sp_id), sp_common, sp_scientific)
nc_xw <- bind_rows(
  read_xw(here("data/sdm/derived/nc_atl_birds_dens/mw_spp.csv")),
  read_xw(here("data/sdm/derived/nc_pac_birds_dens/m_spp.csv")),
  read_xw(here("data/sdm/derived/nc_pac_birds_dens/m_spp-multiple.csv"))) |>
  distinct(sp_code, .keep_all = TRUE)
nc_multi <- read_csv(here("data/sdm/derived/nc_pac_birds_dens/m_spp-multiple.csv"))$sp_code
stopifnot("a model's sp_code has no species row" = all(m$sp_code %in% nc_xw$sp_code))
nc_xw <- nc_xw |> filter(sp_code %in% m$sp_code) |>
  mutate(is_guild = sp_code %in% nc_multi | str_detect(sp_code, "-") | !str_detect(sp_scientific, " ") |
                    str_detect(sp_common, "spp\\.|/"))
stopifnot("expected 82 NCCOS codes, 13 of them guilds" = nrow(nc_xw) == 82, sum(nc_xw$is_guild) == 13)
```

### Crosswalk: common name → scientific name → override, to BirdLife `sisid` and WoRMS AphiaID

The AOU codes are defined by common name, so a common name is the strongest key; the NCCOS scientific
names follow an older taxonomy (`Puffinus gravis` vs *Ardenna gravis*), which is why a name-only match
missed 20 of 79 species and matched three to the WRONG one.

```{r}
#| label: crosswalk

# BirdLife species table (the `bl` model table merge_models_prep.qmd reads its birds from)
bl <- read_csv(glue("{dir_atlas}/dist/model_bl.csv")) |>
  transmute(sisid = as.character(sisid), bl_sci = sci_name, bl_common = common)
norm <- function(x) str_to_lower(str_replace_all(x, "[^A-Za-z]", ""))
bl <- bl |> mutate(k_common = norm(bl_common), k_sci = norm(bl_sci))

# curated overrides (a match the names cannot make)
nc_override <- tribble(
  ~sp_code, ~sisid,     ~note,
  "HERG",   "62030590", "American herring gull = BirdLife Larus smithsonianus (the GBIF name L. argentatus is the European species)")

# common name first; an ambiguous common name is narrowed by scientific name, never guessed
pick_bl <- function(k_common, k_sci) {
  by_common <- bl |> filter(k_common == !!k_common)
  if (nrow(by_common) == 1) return(tibble(sisid = by_common$sisid, match_by = "common name", note = NA_character_))
  if (nrow(by_common) > 1) {
    narrowed <- by_common |> filter(k_sci == !!k_sci)
    if (nrow(narrowed) == 1) return(tibble(sisid = narrowed$sisid, match_by = "common name", note = "common name ambiguous; narrowed by scientific name"))
  }
  by_sci <- bl |> filter(k_sci == !!k_sci)
  if (nrow(by_sci) == 1) return(tibble(sisid = by_sci$sisid, match_by = "scientific name", note = NA_character_))
  tibble(sisid = NA_character_, match_by = NA_character_, note = NA_character_)
}

cw <- nc_xw |> mutate(k_common = norm(sp_common), k_sci = norm(sp_scientific)) |>
  bind_cols(pmap_dfr(list(norm(nc_xw$sp_common), norm(nc_xw$sp_scientific)), pick_bl) |>
              rename(sisid_name = sisid, match_by_name = match_by, note_name = note)) |>
  left_join(nc_override, by = "sp_code") |>
  mutate(sisid    = if_else(is_guild, NA_character_, coalesce(sisid, sisid_name)),
         match_by = case_when(is_guild ~ NA_character_, !is.na(note) & !is.na(sisid) ~ "override",
                              TRUE ~ match_by_name),
         note     = case_when(is_guild ~ sp_common, TRUE ~ coalesce(note, note_name))) |>
  select(-sisid_name, -match_by_name, -note_name, -k_common, -k_sci) |>
  left_join(bl |> select(sisid, bl_sci, bl_common), by = "sisid")

# WoRMS AphiaID by name (BirdLife's accepted name first, then NCCOS's), accepted species of class Aves;
# an unaccepted hit resolves to its accepted AphiaID. WoRMS covers birds poorly, so a miss is a note,
# not a stop: the bird authority is BirdLife (BOTW:{sisid}).
con_spp <- dbConnect(duckdb(path_expand(spp_db), read_only = TRUE))
nm <- unique(na.omit(c(cw$bl_sci, cw$sp_scientific[!cw$is_guild])))
wm <- dbGetQuery(con_spp, glue("
  SELECT scientificName AS nm, CAST(COALESCE(acceptedNameUsageID, taxonID) AS VARCHAR) AS worms_id,
         taxonomicStatus = 'accepted' AS is_acc
  FROM worms WHERE \"class\" = 'Aves' AND taxonRank = 'Species'
    AND scientificName IN ({paste(dbQuoteString(con_spp, nm), collapse = ',')})")) |>
  arrange(desc(is_acc)) |> distinct(nm, .keep_all = TRUE)
dbDisconnect(con_spp, shutdown = TRUE)
cw <- cw |>
  left_join(wm |> transmute(bl_sci = nm, w_bl = worms_id), by = "bl_sci") |>
  left_join(wm |> transmute(sp_scientific = nm, w_nc = worms_id), by = "sp_scientific") |>
  mutate(worms_id = if_else(is_guild, NA_character_, coalesce(w_bl, w_nc))) |> select(-w_bl, -w_nc)

# --- hard stops ----
nong <- cw |> filter(!is_guild)
stopifnot("a non-guild code resolves to nothing" = !anyNA(nong$sisid),
          "two codes resolve to the same BirdLife species" = !anyDuplicated(nong$sisid),
          "two codes share a GBIF id" = !anyDuplicated(nong$gbif_id))
# the three formerly WRONG matches (name-only on GBIF scientific names) must stay impossible:
#  Cory's shearwater -> Calonectris diomedea (Scopoli's, Mediterranean) instead of C. borealis;
#  herring gull -> Larus argentatus (the European species) instead of L. smithsonianus;
#  white-winged scoter -> the European velvet scoter instead of Melanitta deglandi
want <- c(COSH = "Calonectris borealis", HERG = "Larus smithsonianus", WWSC = "Melanitta deglandi")
got  <- setNames(cw$bl_sci[match(names(want), cw$sp_code)], names(want))
stopifnot("the Cory's / herring gull / white-winged scoter crosswalk regressed" = identical(got, want))
# a common-name match must agree with the crosswalk's common name; a name or override match may
# differ only for a curated, known BirdLife rename
common_renamed_ok <- c("DOVE", "PAJA", "HERG")          # Dovekie = Little Auk; Parasitic = Arctic Jaeger; American = Arctic Herring Gull
bad <- nong |> filter(norm(sp_common) != norm(bl_common), !sp_code %in% common_renamed_ok)
stopifnot("a matched species' common name disagrees with the crosswalk" = nrow(bad) == 0)
stopifnot("an override/name match outside the curated list" =
            all(nong$sp_code[nong$match_by != "common name"] %in% common_renamed_ok))

cw_out <- cw |>
  transmute(sp_code, common_name = sp_common, scientific_name = sp_scientific, match_by, worms_id, sisid, is_guild,
            note, gbif_id, sp_id = if_else(is_guild, glue("GUILD:{sp_code}"), gbif_id),
            bl_scientific = bl_sci, bl_common) |>
  arrange(is_guild, sp_code)
write_csv(cw_out, xw_csv, na = "")
log_info("crosswalk: {nrow(cw_out)} codes; {sum(cw_out$is_guild)} guilds; WoRMS id for {sum(!is.na(cw_out$worms_id))} of {sum(!cw_out$is_guild)} species")
knitr::kable(cw_out |> mutate(match_by = coalesce(match_by, "guild")) |> count(match_by, name = "n_codes"),
             caption = "crosswalk: codes by match_by")
knitr::kable(cw_out |> filter(!is_guild, match_by != "common name" | scientific_name != bl_scientific) |>
               select(sp_code, common_name, scientific_name, bl_scientific, bl_common, match_by, sisid, worms_id),
             caption = "species whose NCCOS scientific name differs from BirdLife's, or that matched off the common name")
knitr::kable(cw_out |> filter(is_guild) |> select(sp_code, common_name, scientific_name, sp_id),
             caption = "guilds: ingested as nc|GUILD:{code}, excluded from the merge")

# model table with the ingest's sp_id / names
m <- m |> left_join(cw_out |> select(sp_code, sp_id, common_name, nc_scientific = scientific_name, scientific_name = bl_scientific,
                                     is_guild, sisid, worms_id, match_by), by = "sp_code") |>
  mutate(scientific_name = coalesce(scientific_name, nc_scientific))
log_info("nc models: {nrow(m)} (species×season×region); {n_distinct(m$sp_id)} sp_id; guilds: {n_distinct(m$sp_id[m$is_guild])}")
knitr::kable(m |> count(region, season, name = "n") |> pivot_wider(names_from = season, values_from = n))
```

## Regrid + transform

```{r}
#| label: functions

# a source model's density on the 0.05° cells: bilinear reprojection of the omerc COG to EPSG:4326, then
# cells_from_raster() (bilinear onto the cell grid, zero-filled so the surface fades to 0 at its edge).
# digits = NULL: the raster holds NATIVE density, which rounds to 0 at 2 decimals; min_value is a
# positive epsilon, i.e. "any positive density" (the default 1 would drop every cell of a density < 1)
dens_cells <- function(region_ds, sp_code, season) {
  f <- here(glue("data/sdm/raw/{region_ds}/{sp_code}_{season}.tif"))
  if (!file_exists(f)) return(NULL)
  r <- terra::project(terra::rast(f, lyrs = 1), "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
  msens::cells_from_raster(r, cellid_tif, min_value = 1e-12, digits = NULL) |> rename(dens = val)
}

# density -> [0,100]: the v11 population percentile (ud, area-weighted by the cell table), or the v8
# recipe (cap: linear to the species' pooled p99.5 of positive density, clamped)
to_val <- function(dens, cell_id, how, cap = NA_real_) {
  if (how == "ud") msens::density_to_suit(dens, "ud", area = cell_area(cell_id), digits = 2)
  else             round(100 * pmin(dens / cap, 1), 2)
}

# a species' models in one region as (cell_id, interval, dens)
region_dens <- function(sp_code, region) {
  mi <- m |> filter(sp_code == !!sp_code, region == !!region)
  map2_dfr(mi$region_ds, mi$season, \(rd, s) dens_cells(rd, sp_code, s) |> mutate(interval = s))
}
```

### The annual surface is the mean over ALL four seasons

An unmodelled season counts as zero (NCCOS fits a season only where the species was sighted enough to
model). Checked on the densities, before any transform, on hand-picked species: with four seasons the
annual equals the plain mean of the seasons; a species missing a season has a LOWER annual than the
present-only mean (by exactly n_present / 4).

```{r}
#| label: annual-check

chk <- function(code, region) {
  d   <- region_dens(code, region)
  ann <- msens::density_annual(d, n_intervals = 4)
  wide <- d |> pivot_wider(names_from = interval, values_from = dens, values_fill = 0)
  list(d = d, ann = ann, wide = wide, n = n_distinct(d$interval))
}
chk4 <- list(ATPU = "Atlantic", AUSH = "Atlantic", BFAL = "Pacific", CAAU = "Pacific")   # all four seasons
for (code in names(chk4)) {
  x <- chk(code, chk4[[code]]); stopifnot(x$n == 4)
  plain <- x$wide |> transmute(cell_id, mean4 = rowMeans(across(-cell_id)))
  j <- inner_join(x$ann, plain, by = "cell_id")
  stopifnot("annual != plain 4-season mean" = nrow(j) == nrow(x$ann), nrow(j) == nrow(plain),
            max(abs(j$dens - j$mean4)) < 1e-12 * max(j$mean4))
}
chk3 <- list(ASSP = "Pacific", BLSP = "Pacific", BVSH = "Pacific", BLKI = "Atlantic")   # three seasons
chk_rows <- list()
for (code in names(chk3)) {
  x <- chk(code, chk3[[code]]); stopifnot(x$n == 3)
  present <- x$d |> group_by(cell_id) |> summarise(present_mean = mean(dens), n_ssn = n(), .groups = "drop")
  j <- inner_join(x$ann, present, by = "cell_id")
  stopifnot("annual is not below the present-only mean" = all(j$dens < j$present_mean),
            "annual != present-only mean x n_present/4" = all(abs(j$dens - j$present_mean * j$n_ssn / 4) < 1e-12 * max(j$present_mean)))
  chk_rows[[code]] <- tibble(sp_code = code, seasons = x$n, cells = nrow(j),
                             mean_annual = mean(j$dens), mean_present_only = mean(j$present_mean))
}
log_info("annual checks passed: {length(chk4)} four-season species (annual == plain mean), {length(chk3)} three-season species (annual < present-only mean)")
knitr::kable(bind_rows(chk_rows) |> mutate(across(starts_with("mean"), \(v) signif(v, 3))),
             caption = "three-season species: annual vs the present-only mean the v8 ingest used (cell means)")
```

```{r}
#| label: rasterize

# per sp_id: regrid every (region × season) model, add the per-region annual (density_annual on the
# DENSITIES), transform each model on its own cells (both recipes, for the comparison), write the
# selected one with the regions unioned per season. resumable (skip existing parquet) unless REDO_INGEST.
sp_ids   <- sort(unique(m$sp_id))
cmp_rows <- list(); cap_rows <- list()
for (sid in sp_ids) {
  mi   <- m |> filter(sp_id == sid)
  safe <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", sid)
  done <- all(file_exists(glue("{dir_dist}/{ds_key}_{safe}_{unique(mi$season)}.parquet"))) &&
          file_exists(glue("{dir_dist}/{ds_key}_{safe}.parquet"))
  if (done && !redo_ingest) next

  dl   <- pmap(list(mi$region_ds, mi$sp_code, mi$season), dens_cells)
  keep <- !vapply(dl, is.null, logical(1)); mi <- mi[keep, ]; dl <- dl[keep]
  if (!length(dl)) { log_warn("no source rasters for {sid}"); next }
  dd <- map_dfr(seq_along(dl), \(j) dl[[j]] |> mutate(region = mi$region[j], interval = mi$season[j]))
  # the v8 recipe's 100 point: pooled p99.5 of the species' positive densities (all seasons, both regions)
  cap <- as.numeric(quantile(dd$dens, p_cap, names = FALSE))
  if (!is.finite(cap) || cap <= 0) cap <- max(dd$dens)
  # annual per region: mean over 4 seasons, an unmodelled season = 0
  ann <- dd |> group_by(region) |>
    group_modify(\(x, k) msens::density_annual(x, n_intervals = 4)) |> ungroup() |> mutate(interval = "annual")
  res <- bind_rows(dd, ann) |> group_by(region, interval) |>
    group_modify(\(x, k) tibble(cell_id = x$cell_id, dens = x$dens,
                                v_ud = to_val(x$dens, x$cell_id, "ud"), v_cap = to_val(x$dens, x$cell_id, "cap", cap))) |>
    ungroup() |> mutate(val = if (nc_transform == "ud") v_ud else v_cap)

  # per-model comparison of the two recipes (cells written = val >= 1)
  q <- \(v) quantile(v, c(.1, .5, .9), names = FALSE)
  cmp_rows[[sid]] <- res |> group_by(region, interval) |>
    summarise(n_cells = n(), n_ud = sum(v_ud >= 1), n_cap = sum(v_cap >= 1),
              ud_q10 = q(v_ud[v_ud >= 1])[1], ud_q50 = q(v_ud[v_ud >= 1])[2], ud_q90 = q(v_ud[v_ud >= 1])[3],
              cap_q10 = q(v_cap[v_cap >= 1])[1], cap_q50 = q(v_cap[v_cap >= 1])[2], cap_q90 = q(v_cap[v_cap >= 1])[3],
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(sp_id = sid, sp_code = mi$sp_code[1], .before = 1)
  cap_rows[[sid]] <- tibble(sp_id = sid, dens_cap = cap)

  # one surface per interval, regions unioned (disjoint; max where they touch)
  for (iv in unique(res$interval)) {
    d <- res |> filter(interval == iv, val >= 1) |> group_by(cell_id) |> summarise(val = max(val), .groups = "drop")
    if (!nrow(d)) next
    write_parquet_row(d, sid, if (iv == "annual") NA_character_ else iv, safe)
  }
}
log_info("rasterized {length(cmp_rows)} sp_id ({nc_transform})")
```

## Model registry (`model_nc.csv`) + transform comparison

```{r}
#| label: model-csv

# stats of every written surface, read back from the parquet (so a resumed run is complete too)
con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
duckdb_tune(con, glue("{dir_big_v}/_tmp/nc"))
surf <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
  SELECT mdl_key, count(*) AS n_cells, round(min(val), 2) AS val_min, round(max(val), 2) AS val_max
  FROM read_parquet('{dir_dist}/*.parquet') GROUP BY mdl_key"))
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

# dens_cap per sp_id: this run's, else the previous registry's (resume)
caps <- bind_rows(cap_rows)
prev_nc <- if (file_exists(mdl_csv)) read_csv(mdl_csv) else tibble()
if ("dens_cap" %in% names(prev_nc))
  caps <- bind_rows(caps, prev_nc |> distinct(sp_id, dens_cap) |> filter(!sp_id %in% caps$sp_id))
meta <- m |> group_by(sp_id) |>
  summarise(sp_code = first(sp_code), common_name = first(common_name), scientific_name = first(scientific_name),
            nc_scientific_name = first(nc_scientific), is_guild = first(is_guild), sisid = first(sisid),
            worms_id = first(worms_id), match_by = first(match_by),
            regions = paste(sort(unique(region)), collapse = "|"),
            response_type = if (n_distinct(response_type) == 1) first(response_type) else "mixed",
            seasons = list(sort(unique(season))), .groups = "drop")
# a model row per surface written: the seasonal ones + the annual
model_nc <- meta |> rowwise() |>
  reframe(sp_id, interval = c(seasons, "annual")) |>
  left_join(meta |> select(-seasons), by = "sp_id") |>
  mutate(mdl_key = if_else(interval == "annual", glue("{ds_key}|{sp_id}"), glue("{ds_key}|{sp_id}|{interval}")),
         transform = nc_transform) |>
  left_join(caps, by = "sp_id") |>
  inner_join(surf, by = "mdl_key") |>
  left_join(m |> group_by(sp_id, interval = season) |>
              summarise(cog_url = paste(cog_url, collapse = "|"), .groups = "drop"), by = c("sp_id", "interval")) |>
  select(mdl_key, interval, sp_id, sp_code, common_name, scientific_name, nc_scientific_name, is_guild, sisid, worms_id,
         match_by, regions, response_type, transform, dens_cap, val_min, val_max, n_cells, cog_url) |>
  arrange(sp_id, interval)
stopifnot("val outside [1,100]" = all(model_nc$val_min >= 1 & model_nc$val_max <= 100),
          "a model has no dens_cap" = !anyNA(model_nc$dens_cap),
          "every guild code must be ingested" = setequal(model_nc$sp_code[model_nc$is_guild], cw_out$sp_code[cw_out$is_guild]),
          "nc|GUILD key missing" = all(grepl("^nc\\|GUILD:", model_nc$mdl_key[model_nc$is_guild])),
          "every species has an annual surface" = all(table(model_nc$sp_id, model_nc$interval == "annual")[, "TRUE"] == 1))
write_csv(model_nc, mdl_csv)
log_info("model_nc.csv: {nrow(model_nc)} mdl_keys ({sum(model_nc$interval=='annual')} annual, {n_distinct(model_nc$sp_id)} sp_id, {n_distinct(model_nc$sp_id[model_nc$is_guild])} guilds)")
knitr::kable(model_nc |> count(interval, name = "n"))
knitr::kable(model_nc |> distinct(sp_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |> count(response_type, regions, is_guild, name = "n_sp_id"),
             caption = "sp_id by response type (Atlantic Winship 2018 = relative_index), regions and guild")

# the two recipes side by side, per model (species × region × season|annual); persisted so a resumed
# run keeps the rows of the species it skipped
cmp <- bind_rows(cmp_rows)
if (file_exists(cmp_csv)) cmp <- bind_rows(cmp, read_csv(cmp_csv) |> filter(!sp_id %in% cmp$sp_id))
cmp <- cmp |> arrange(sp_id, region, interval)
write_csv(cmp |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(v) signif(v, 5))), cmp_csv)
```

```{r}
#| label: compare-transforms
#| results: asis

cat(glue("**{nrow(cmp)} models** (species × region × season, plus annual per region). `n_cells` = cells with a positive ",
         "density; `n_ud` / `n_cap` = cells kept (`val >= 1`) under each recipe; the quantiles are over the kept cells. ",
         "The written surface is `{nc_transform}`.\n\n"))
print(knitr::kable(
  cmp |> mutate(kind = if_else(interval == "annual", "annual", "seasonal")) |> group_by(kind) |>
    summarise(models = n(), across(c(n_cells, n_ud, n_cap, ud_q10, ud_q50, ud_q90, cap_q10, cap_q50, cap_q90), \(v) round(median(v), 1)),
              .groups = "drop"),
  caption = "median over models, by kind"))
cat("\n\n<details><summary>every model, both recipes</summary>\n\n")
print(knitr::kable(cmp |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(v) round(v, 1)))))
cat("\n\n</details>\n\n")
```

## Manifest

```{r}
#| label: manifest

# content-addressed, deterministic manifest (Phase A) — no wall-clock, so an identical re-ingest
# produces byte-identical bytes and does NOT invalidate downstream targets.
h    <- msens::hash_parquet(glue("{dir_dist}/*.parquet"))
smry <- arrow::open_dataset(dir_dist) |>
  summarise(n_rows = n(), n_mdl = n_distinct(mdl_key),
            val_min = round(min(val), 2), val_max = round(max(val), 2)) |> collect()
msens::report_table(smry, caption = glue("nc density model_cell surface (density → population percentile [1,100], {nc_transform})"))

msens::write_manifest(
  manifest, target = "ingest_sdm_nc", content_hash = h,
  stats = list(
    ds_key = ds_key, n_sp_id = n_distinct(model_nc$sp_id), n_mdl = nrow(model_nc),
    n_guild = n_distinct(model_nc$sp_id[model_nc$is_guild]), transform = nc_transform, p_cap = p_cap,
    atl_source = nc_atl_source,
    note = "seasonal + annual density -> population percentile [1,100]; annual = mean over 4 seasons (unmodelled = 0) then transformed; guilds ingested, excluded from the merge; NOT yet folded into merge/scoring"),
  force = msens::force_target("ingest_sdm_nc"))
```
